create_fastlinear_layer: create a FastLinear torch module with weight and bias parameters for linear transformations
create_fastlinearrocm_layer: create a FastLinearROCm module that uses optimized skinny GEMM operations on ROCm GPUs
load_fastlinear_weights: load a FastLinear layer from checkpoint weights using a prefix path and bias flag
load_fastlinearrocm_weights: load a FastLinearROCm layer from checkpoint weights using a prefix path and bias flag
get_linear_factory: use get_linear to create the appropriate linear layer based on the system platform and weight type
